findings.standard: An Instar Agent Is Always a Multi-Machine Entity
findings.reason: The design allows a completed App reply’s only surviving copy to lose which message it answered, although completed answers require all-member durability and the Pending exception covers only temporary gaps.
Replay or rollback through an older codec can permanently erase the only copy of a reply relation needed to interpret the conversation, without an operator deletion request or erasure obligation.

fit.reason: Opening the selected message automatically improves the operator’s experience, but the design chiefly governs message identity and access while leaving primary-action visibility, plain-language presentation, and phone-width usability unspecified.
